name: tsv
description: tsv's development root, never published: the npm packages are assembled under crates/tsv_wasm/pkg and crates/tsv_napi/pkg

scripts.install-cli: cargo build --release -p tsv_cli && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp target/release/tsv ~/.local/bin/tsv
scripts.dev: cargo watch -x 'check --workspace' -x 'test --workspace' || echo '⚠️  cargo-watch not installed. Run: cargo install cargo-watch'
scripts.typecheck:features: RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_ffi -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/format,tsv_ffi/format,tsv_napi/format && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_ffi -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/parse,tsv_ffi/parse,tsv_napi/parse && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/strip,tsv_napi/strip && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/imports,tsv_napi/imports && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_ts -p tsv_css -p tsv_svelte --all-targets && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_svelte --features smallvec/union
scripts.canonicalize:audit: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet canonicalize_audit tests/fixtures tests/fixtures_compile
scripts.docs:audit: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -D rustdoc::invalid_html_tags -D rustdoc::bare_urls -D rustdoc::redundant_explicit_links -A rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items --all-features --quiet
scripts.test:node: node node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && node node_modules/.bin/vitest run
scripts.test:node:canonical: node node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.canonical.json && node node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.canonical.config.ts
scripts.test:depth: cargo test --profile corpus -p tsv_tests --features tsv_debug/_internal_audits --test depth_limit --quiet
scripts.test:depth:napi: TSV_DEPTH_SWEEP=full cargo test --profile napi -p tsv_tests --test depth_limit --quiet
scripts.fuzz:audit:css: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded css
scripts.fuzz:audit:ts: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded ts tests/fixtures tests/fixtures_strip tests/fixtures_imports
scripts.fuzz:audit:debug: cargo run --profile corpus-debug -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 && cargo run --profile corpus-debug -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded css && cargo run --profile corpus-debug -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded ts tests/fixtures tests/fixtures_strip tests/fixtures_imports
scripts.bench:runtimes: (node -e 'if (globalThis.Deno) process.exit(1); const [a, b] = process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number); if (a < 22 || (a === 22 && b < 18)) process.exit(1)' 2> /dev/null || (echo '✗ bench needs node (>=22.18, native TS type-stripping) — a real node, not the deno node-compat shim — install it, or run the per-runtime tasks: deno task bench:deno' && exit 1)) && (which bun > /dev/null || (echo '✗ bench needs bun — install it, or run the per-runtime tasks: deno task bench:deno && deno task bench:node && deno task bench:compose' && exit 1))
scripts.bench:clean: rm -rf benches/js/results/baseline.json benches/js/results/[0-9]*.json benches/js/results/[0-9]*.md benches/js/results/.run-* benches/js/.cache
scripts.conformance:tsc-check: cargo run -p tsv_debug --quiet tsc_conformance run --report benches/js/results/report.tsc-conformance
scripts.conformance:tsc-check:update: cargo run -p tsv_debug --quiet tsc_conformance run --update --report benches/js/results/report.tsc-conformance
